The overall behavior is right: automatic details make saving feel easy, the tag suggestions work the way I’d expect, and a duplicate should open the existing bookmark without overwriting anything automatically.

When it opens for editing, though, I also need to be able to change the title and the link itself, not just the description, tags, and note. I’d also expect the automatic page details to include a preview image when the page provides one. With those additions, this saving flow matches what I want.
